name: PrimTObject::Prim76 (SimAntics opcode 0x76, ArrayOperation)
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). Operates on the array of 16-bit values (a three-pointer vector: first, last, end) that the target's slot 265 hands out (count: slot 266; target: this or the object the context's slot-26 table gives for the id of the secondary slot 20 object's slot 12, error 8). Operations (param byte +5): 0 clear, 1 length into the operand, 2 resize (zero fill), 3 fill, 4 insert front, 5 append, 6 insert at index, 7 erase front, 8 erase back, 9 erase at index, 10 find from index, 11 swap, 12 sort descending, 13 sort ascending, else error 1; errors 0x6c (array number/count/missing), 0x6d (index/empty), 0x13/0x14 (destination). The game's unoptimised vector helpers (0x5a9a10 clear, 0x57b6f0 resize, 0x52bf90 grow-resize, 0x57bc90 insert, 0x47b780 grow-insert, 0x5798a0/0x5799b0 push_back, 0x5a9ca0 erase, 0x57bef0 find, 0x57c080/0x57c000 sort and the introsort pieces under them) are reproduced inline, not separately hooked: the capacity growth (1.5x, at least the size needed) is compared. Negative resize and an overlong vector throw std::length_error('vector too long'). Allocations go through the allocator service (AllocateViaAllocatorService/FreeThroughAllocatorService); the test installs a heap-backed fake as the cached service. Differential: 60,000 seeds with exception injection against recording fakes (call trace, thrown code, return, operand destinations, and the array's size/capacity/contents after each run). Mutants killed (17): growth rule, sort direction, find start, erase length, both zero fills, length value, insert index, count/number bound, middle-insert shift, null array code, find-miss return, destination error code, front/back insert position, empty-erase error, swap bound, insert-when-full branch.

name: PrimTObject::Prim71 (SimAntics opcode 0x71, SnapInto)
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). Two object operands (error 0x17 when the table's slot 30 finds none), slot number from param byte +0xa or this slot 19(0); clears this slot-14 entries 0x34 and 0x36; snap-test state 0x7f02f0/0x7f04e0 (destructor also when a throw leaves), snap check 0x7e8aa0, report builder 0x7f0ca0, string-table entry lookup 0x7f0c00 and the message server getter 0x9c5a89 are original callees. Success: slot 174 of B and the optional query (slot 9 -> slot 85, released through its virtual base), then a framework message (0xaf6129b0, B) to the server when B's slot 98 says 0x13. Failure: context slot 31 (al only) picks the diagnostic walk (interface 0x5a69d3d5 objects' owner names and ids; the original formats text into locals and drops it: not reproduced, only the calls) before slot 14 (0x34, code + 2). ORIGINAL-BUG: the diagnostic walk queries the object slot 29 returns for B's slot-73 id without a null check. The message constructor 0x1c033d is inlined (as lane R does). Differential: 80,000 seeds with exception injection, original callees as logging stand-ins in the mapped image on both sides, message block from the allocator with recording vtable slots. Mutants killed (32): operand ids/scopes, slot arguments, flag bits, query iids, 0x13 compare (full eax and al), message id/value/AddRef, virtual-base release, guards (state, report), context slot 31 (al versus eax), error code +2/+3, entry text gate, interface object, objB slot 72/73, holder AddRef, second table fetch, frame slot. Lane AJ: the report builder 0x7f0ca0 and the message lookup 0x7f0c00 are ours now (SnapReport.cpp); the test puts its stand-ins over our functions as well as over the originals.

name: PrimTObject::Prim24 (SimAntics opcode 0x24, Dialog)
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). Param byte +9 picks the action: 9 asks the dialog list (dialog service 0x20e031 slot 3) whether this's slot-19(selector) dialog is up; 8/0x0a/0x1c create a dialog (text from string table 0x12d through the cTSString loaders 0x1d0e90, stack object slot 262, mode bits, list slot 3 or this slot 19 + list slot 4, flags via slots 6/7 and this slot 20); 0x39 opens a popup for a game tip (GetTip, slot 4 of the game tip service from GetGameTipService 0xb39020, ours since lane LB; the test now also runs without a tip service, every eighth seed: cache 0x10faf8c and framework 0x10c9378 empty; LB mutants, all killed: the service's null check dropped, GetTip's instance changed, a refused tip returning 2); 0x16/0x19 build a message from three loaded texts (third parsed by 0x1b0e2c) for the UI object's 6-argument slot 16, or close the dialog; every other opcode goes to the table's slot 78 or is answered from the pending entry's state (slot 7: 0..4). Returns 0/1/2. Arities of slots were settled by stack analysis (several decompiler argument lists were wrong: this slot 19 takes one argument, the list's slot 4 five, UI slot 16 six, holder slot 8 none). ORIGINAL-BUG: opcodes 0x16/0x19 use the stack object without a null check; the state service getter result is used unchecked. Differential: 80,000 seeds with exception injection against recording fakes (text arguments logged by content); the string loaders run as original code on both sides. Mutants (62): 61 killed; one survivor is equivalent (the loader takes the entry as a word, so masking it first changes nothing); the mOwner mutant first survived because the fake shared the frame object, fixed by a distinct object and killed. Killed: operand/flag bits, slot numbers and arguments, error codes (0x17, 0x37, 0x6c), return codes, service gates, string selection and number parsing.

name: PrimTObject::Prim17 (SimAntics opcode 0x17, PlaySound)
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). Sound number (param word +4; negative: operand; 10000/20000 select the frame kind object's slot 14/15 else 16), owner id from this slot 47 or frame slot 12 (flag byte +8). The director framework object (GetDirectorFrameworkObject, ours) creates the sound lookup object (clsid 0x1c03c383): slot 3 tests the sound, slot 5 gives its name (lower-cased). When the sound system is up (0x9c5b7e) a message (clsid 0xcbc79579) is filled from the owner object (flag word slot 13(0x22): bit 1 or bit 4 with a 'vox' prefix send nothing; attributes via slot 12/15; position and direction either from its cell (0x7dcc00) and a heading (sin/cos 0x5a9de0/0x5a9a90) or from the skeleton node 'root_rot' (0xae7490) and a quaternion rotation (0x1a6c40), z clamped to >= 0 with the comiss rule) plus name, owner id and a flag-selected id, and posted to the server (0x9c5a89 slot 3). Always returns 1. The debug text the original builds in locals (' Sound: id %d, ...') is not reproduced, only its calls (owner slot 92). ORIGINAL-BUG: when the interface exists but the skeleton query (slot 12) fails, position and direction are sent uninitialised (ours sends zeros); not testable. Slot arities settled by stack analysis (decompiler lists were wrong in places). Differential: 80,000 seeds with exception injection against recording fakes; the director singleton is set up as in the Prim10 test; 0x9c5b7e, 0xae7490 and 0x7dcc00 (terrain read) are logging stand-ins, sin/cos and the rotation run as original code. Mutants killed (59): flags, index arithmetic, kind selection, operand read, lookup gates, lower-casing, ids, attribute copies, vector math, z clamp, message ids and arguments, server argument. Two equivalents: 'vox' case-sensitivity (the name is lower-cased before) first, and the server argument (killed after the fixture gave the reply its own object). Lane RY: the call to the tile maths (0x7dcc00) now goes to ours (src/world/WorldTileMath).
